faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by PM SHRI School Kumuram Bheem Asifabad under the education sector in the state of Telangana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts offered are Guest Special Needs Educators for PM SHRI Schools with a total of 14 available vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary provided for Guest Special Needs Educators?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 16,500/- per month as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form along with necessary documents is 11 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Ed (Special Education), B.Ed (General) with a Special Education Diploma, or a Special Education PG Diploma recognized by RCI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through both online and offline modes by submitting required documents to the designated office.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 14 vacancies have been announced, distributed among schools with existing and non-existing DDO codes.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the offline application be submitted?
faq.answer: Hard copies of applications along with self-attested documents must be submitted to the District Educational Office, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, Idoc S-17.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by PM SHRI School Kumuram Bheem Asifabad.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications followed by selection based strictly on guidelines issued by State Samagra Shiksha.
